exam_scheme.note: Recruitment of Sub-Inspectors of Police by TNUSRB features a comprehensive four-stage selection process: Stage 1 Written Examination (Part I Tamil Language Eligibility Test & Part II Main Written Examination), Stage 2 Certificate Verification, Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Endurance Test (ET), and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Stage 3 Viva-Voce (Interview), and Stage 4 Special Marks (NCC, NSS & Sports). Final merit is compiled out of 100 marks (70 Written + 15 PET + 10 Viva-Voce + 5 Special Marks).

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Written Examination (Part I Tamil Eligibility & Part II Main Examination)
stages.source_label: TNUSRB Notification No. 01/2025, Section 15 & 16: Marks Allocation and Scheme of Written Examination

papers.paper_name: Part I — Tamil Language Eligibility Test (10th Standard Standard, 100 MCQs)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% (40 marks); mandatory qualifying test, marks not counted for ranking or provisional selection

papers.paper_name: Part II — Main Written Examination: Part A General Knowledge (80 MCQs / 40 Marks) & Part B Logical/Psychology (60 MCQs / 30 Marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 35% (25 marks) minimum qualifying mark; candidates shortlisted in 1:5 ratio for CV-PMT-ET-PET

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Physical Examination (CV, PMT, ET & PET)
stages.source_label: TNUSRB Notification No. 01/2025, Section 16-B: Physical Measurement, Endurance & Efficiency Tests

papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying only. Height: Men (170 cm OC/BC/MBC, 167 cm SC/ST), Women (159 cm OC/BC/MBC, 157 cm SC/ST). Chest (Men): 81 cm with 5 cm expansion. Endurance: Men 1500m in 7 mins; Women 400m in 2m 30s

papers.paper_name: Physical Efficiency Test (PET: 3 Events, One Star = 2 Marks, Two Stars = 5 Marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Total 15 marks. Men: Rope Climbing (5.0m=2mks, 6.0m=5mks), Long Jump (3.80m=2mks, 4.50m=5mks) or High Jump (1.20m=2mks, 1.40m=5mks), 100m (15.0s=2mks, 13.5s=5mks) or 400m run (80.0s=2mks, 70.0s=5mks)

stages.source_label: TNUSRB Notification No. 01/2025, Section 16-C & Section 21: Viva-Voce and Special Marks

papers.qualifying_threshold: Shortlisted in 1:2 ratio based on combined marks of Main Written Examination and Physical Efficiency Test

papers.paper_name: Special Marks (NCC, NSS & Sports / Games Certificates)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Maximum 5 marks: NCC certificates up to 2 marks, NSS certificates up to 1 mark, and approved Sports/Games participation up to 2 marks

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspectors of Police in Tamil Nadu are paid under Level 13 of the Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Matrix (₹36,900 - ₹1,16,600 under G.O. Ms. No. 303, Finance (Pay Cell) Department, dated 11.10.2017). Executive police personnel receive Risk Allowance, City Compensatory Allowance, Kit Maintenance Allowance, and Station Grade HRA.
financial_package.pay_source_label: TNUSRB SI Notification No. 01/2025, Section 4: Scale of Pay (Rs. 36,900 - 1,16,600, Level 13 under Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Matrix)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimate assumes Level 13 entry basic pay ₹36,900 with 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025) plus Tamil Nadu Grade-classified HRA (₹1,600 to ₹4,800), City Compensatory Allowance (₹600 to ₹1,200), Police Uniform/Kit Allowance, and Risk Allowance. Deductions account for Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS 10% of Basic+DA), NHIS, and professional tax.
official_perks: Medical insurance coverage under New Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) for police officers and eligible family members
Police Risk Allowance and Executive Uniform / Kit Maintenance Allowance
Government quarters / official police housing or HRA as per station classification
Subsidized provisions and grocery supplies via Tamil Nadu Police Canteens
Festival advance and special Pongal bonus as sanctioned by the State Government

competition_benchmarks.note: TNUSRB Sub-Inspector of Police is among the most sought-after state executive recruitments in Tamil Nadu, drawing over 1.5 lakh graduate applicants per cycle for both Open and 20% Departmental quotas.
